scope: Proposition 6.11 (Gaussian moment recursion) of the manuscript “The joint scaling limit of critical Ashkin-Teller currents” (preprints/The-joint-scaling-limit-of-critical-Ashkin-Teller-currents-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 233 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cec129cca8c2a0a6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 57. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every j ≥ 2 and distinct points in U, Tj(x1, . . . , xj) = κ j X i=2 GU (x1, xi)Tj−2(x2, . . . , b xi, . . . , xj). (6.13) Consequently the limiting centered field in U is a Gaussian field with covariance κGU . In particular its restrictions to different components are independent.
